## Checklist

- [ ] PR title is a Conventional Commit, e.g. `feat(web): add email verification flow`
- [ ] Branch name follows the rules, e.g. `feature/123-add-login`
- [ ] Targets `develop` (`main` only for a hotfix)
- [ ] `npm run lint`, `npm run typecheck` and `npm test` pass locally
- [ ] Changed files are formatted with Prettier
- [ ] Tested locally, including loading, empty and error states for UI changes
- [ ] No secrets, `.env` values, keys or keystores committed
- [ ] No unnecessary files (build output, logs, debug code, temporary files)
- [ ] Database migrations are backward-compatible, or there are none
- [ ] Documentation updated where behaviour changed
- [ ] Breaking change: marked with `!` in the title and explained below
